## History

Clarice Almira is a pupil in the school where [Anne](../character/anne.md) begins teaching. Her mother, Mrs. Donnell, visits the school after class to demand specific pronunciations and names for her children, including Clarice.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P2](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0002), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P14](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0014), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P15](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0015), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P16](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0016), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P17](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0017), +8 more_
